name: lexie
description: Hide the labels on a diagram and quiz yourself on them.

interface.longDescription:
Attach a labelled diagram, a slide or a PDF, and Lexie hides every label. Type each one from memory and see at once whether you got it right. Switch between Hide all and Hide one, the two image occlusion modes students know from Anki.

Lexie works for anatomy, biology, chemistry, physics, geography and any figure with its labels written on it. A PDF of lecture slides becomes one quiz with a card for every labelled figure.

Save a diagram in Lexie to practise it again later on lexielearn.com or in the Lexie app. A quiz you do not save is deleted after 24 hours.
defaultPrompt: Quiz me on the labels of this diagram
Quiz me on the parts of this anatomy diagram
Make image occlusion cards from these lecture slides

positive.description: Quiz on the labels of an attached diagram
positive.prompt: Quiz me on the labels of this diagram
positive.expected_behavior: Lexie shows a quiz card with the heart diagram and every label hidden. The student types each label; a right answer shows in green, a wrong one in red with the correct label. The reply in the chat does not list the labels.

positive.description: Quiz on a diagram without naming Lexie
positive.prompt: Quiz me on the parts of this brain diagram
positive.expected_behavior: Lexie shows a quiz card with the brain diagram and its labels hidden, one label asked at a time.

positive.prompt: Make image occlusion cards from this
positive.expected_behavior: Lexie shows a quiz card with the foot diagram and its labels hidden. The card has Hide all and Hide one, and Save this in Lexie opens the set on lexielearn.com.

positive.prompt: Hide all, guess one: quiz me on this heart
positive.expected_behavior: Lexie shows the quiz card. Hide one covers only the label being asked; Hide all covers every label.

positive.prompt: Quiz me on the labels in this picture
positive.expected_behavior: Lexie finds no labels to hide and says so: send a diagram with its labels written on it. No quiz card is shown.

negative.prompt: Explain how the heart pumps blood.

negative.description: A request to draw a new diagram
negative.prompt: Draw me a labelled diagram of the human heart.

review.commerce_description: Lexie sells nothing inside ChatGPT. The plugin shows no plans or prices.

publication.release_notes: First release: hide the labels on an attached diagram, slide or PDF and quiz yourself in a card in the chat.
